purpose: Independent confirmation of the valid 2D v1b pilot without any parameter changes.
frozen_source: 2D/v1b_corrected (formula selfcheck max absolute error 0 against 1D v9 reference)
primary_metric: paired d = log10(MSE_PreCap / MSE_reference); d < 0 favors PreCap
primary_gate: At least 2 of 3 tasks must have median d < 0 against both SiLU and GELU, with no higher PreCap bad-rate.
rule: No changes to formula, tasks, width, depths, optimizer, initialization, training steps, or analysis gate after launch.
